verdict.rationale: Neon documents project-scoped API keys that only org admins can create, plus CLI commands to create, list and revoke them. Its MCP server adds least-privilege grants (read-only mode, tool-category scopes, single-project mode), and a keyless probe confirmed a scoped read-only grant actually trims the tool list. The MCP tool surface also lists issuing, revoking and rotating scoped credentials on a branch. missing for 10: permission-level scopes (such as read-only) on Management API keys themselves, in-depth documentation of the branch-scoped credential tool beyond a tool-list mention.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Project-scoped API Key (Organization administrators; Single specified project)
The `api-keys` command creates, lists, and revokes the API keys that authenticate requests to the Neon API.
Scopes the agent to a single project. Hides project-wide management tools
scoped credentials ("Issue a scoped credential on the branch", revoke, rotate)
